resolution: Live churntrace named the remaining spike source as pure prop-identity churn from PropertiesPanel ScrollView.contentContainerStyle and Scene3DBase.scene3dFogColor while the host spike baked +70 atlas glyphs and flipped the StaticSurface frame hash. I changed the host prop diff to shallow-compare style-like object props instead of treating equal-value style objects as dirty by identity, stabilized Scene3D.Fog's auto fog color sentinel so disabled/default fog does not allocate a fresh array per render, and hoisted the PropertiesPanel ScrollView style objects at the call site. This targets only the named heartbeat and leaves user data and timing untouched. Verified with SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship hmsc-int and ./tools/rjit game verify green; live user confirmation is still required for PASS.
